title: The coordinator's wake reads each tracked lane's last push and acts on a lane that has pushed nothing for too long
why:
Consultant 10:35 CST Nov 14 (relayed; the counts are the consultant's, triage read none of them; owner priority fb-1556-6, an owner feedback item): seven CI-speed lanes (PRs #3158, #3180, #2839, #3063, #3226, #2970 and #2733) pushed nothing for about 10 h after the coordinator read them as alive at 00:17 CST, and the lane shared-savings-gap-read sat in review_ready for 9.5 h. Nobody noticed until the owner's consultant asked. Fix shape (consultant's, undone and unbuilt): at each wake the coordinator reads each tracked lane's last push; over 1 h idle means a nudge, over 2 h means replace the lane. The two thresholds are the consultant's picks, unmeasured. Kin, not the same: idle-lane-archive and merge-runs-idle-lanes list lanes whose work has merged, so they can be archived; this step finds a live lane that has stopped. Cost check (rule outcomes-mechanize-rules): the read is one on-demand git or REST read per tracked lane inside a wake the coordinator already runs, no new process, no new file; a test must prove that cost. First act of a lane: read how the coordinator's wake lists tracked lanes today and where a last-push read fits; reproduce, red then green: a lane with a last push over 2 h old is named replace and one over 1 h is named nudge. A lane that waits on the owner or on CI is not idle: the check needs a stated way to tell them apart. INCIDENT 15:11 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 15:09; n=1): the lane of grant-line-not-grant-word sat idle 04:19 to 15:09 CST with a handed-in-ready PR (#3318) the coordinator never listed; found only when the owner said "rush its fix". INCIDENT 16:25 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 16:24, its own miss; both found by the consultant's 16:23 check): the coordinator missed a blocked lane's question to it for 55 min (#3421 lane, 15:28 to 16:23 CST), and #3212 and #3270 sat unplaced since Nov 13. Guard (the coordinator's proposal, an addition to this step): a list of lanes whose last turn ends with a question to the parent and no later message from the parent would have shown it.

00:30 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, data; lane read live by get_session at 00:30 CST: running, connected, created 00:28 CST, parent the coordinator): lane started on this step: session_013NEJL2xup2jFqdwfWBnnN8. The step sat ready with no lane for 7+ hours (the coordinator's audit; relayed, not measured by triage from the step dates).
